entities.summary: Norman Eugene Stewart is an American retired college basketball coach and player and a former minor league baseball player. He coached at the University of Northern Iowa from 1961 to 1967, but is best known for his career with the University of Missouri from 1967 until 1999. He retired with an overall coaching record of 731–375 in 38 seasons. The court at Mizzou Arena is named in his honor.
